C_BOOT.derivation: Cboot_min = (Qg_total + I_leakage × t_on_max) / ΔV_allowed. Where Qg = 120nC (IPP80N05S4-02), I_leakage ≈ 100µA (IR2110), t_on_max = 2µs (500kHz worst case), ΔV_allowed = 1V. Result: 320nF minimum, selected 0.47µF for 47% margin.

D_BOOT.reference: IR2110 datasheet recommends fast-recovery or Schottky diode for bootstrap circuit. Schottky preferred for low forward drop and fast recovery at 100-500kHz.

R_GATE_HIGH.derivation: Gate resistor balances switching speed vs ringing. Turn-on time: t_on ≈ Rgate × Qg / Vgs ≈ 5Ω × 120nC / 12V = 50ns. Peak gate current: I_peak = 12V / 5Ω = 2.4A (within IR2110 2A typical, 2.5A max capability). Lower R reduces losses, higher R reduces EMI.

R_GATE_LOW.derivation: Same calculation as R_GATE_HIGH. Symmetric gate drive for both FETs ensures balanced switching characteristics.

R_SG_HIGH.reference: IR2110 application notes and industry standard practice. 10kΩ provides gate discharge path without loading driver. Prevents Miller turn-on from dv/dt during complementary FET switching. Gate leakage current: Vgs_max / R = 12V / 10kΩ = 1.2mA (negligible).
R_SG_HIGH.margin: Typical range 10k-100k, 10k selected for faster gate discharge

R_SG_LOW.reference: Same as R_SG_HIGH. Symmetric gate discharge for both FETs.

C_VCC_CERAMIC.reference: IR2110 datasheet section on supply decoupling. 0.1µF ceramic capacitor close to VCC pin provides high-frequency bypass for switching transients.
C_VCC_CERAMIC.margin: Standard value for gate driver ICs

C_VCC_BULK.reference: IR2110 application notes recommend bulk capacitance for VCC supply. Provides charge reservoir for bootstrap recharge events. At 500kHz, recharge every 2µs requires low-ESR bulk cap.

C_VDD.reference: IR2110 datasheet. VDD logic supply requires 0.1µF ceramic bypass for noise immunity on input circuits.

R_SNUB_Q1.derivation: RC snubber for critical damping: R = sqrt(L_parasitic / C_parasitic). For TO-220 package, L ≈ 10nH, C_oss ≈ 100pF → R ≈ sqrt(10nH / 100pF) ≈ 10Ω. Provides damping at resonant frequency f = 1/(2π√LC) ≈ 160MHz.
R_SNUB_Q1.margin: Optional - DNF, populate if ringing observed

C_SNUB_Q1.derivation: Snubber capacitor selected to provide pole at ~10MHz (above switching frequency, below parasitic resonance). C × R = 1nF × 10Ω = 10ns time constant → f = 16MHz. C0G/NP0 dielectric for low loss.
C_SNUB_Q1.margin: Optional - DNF, populate if ringing observed

R_SNUB_Q2.derivation: Same as R_SNUB_Q1. Symmetric snubber networks for both FETs.

C_SNUB_Q2.derivation: Same as C_SNUB_Q1. Symmetric snubber networks.
